Given within one day of expiration, when I setDownloadNotifierToTriggerAtHalfwayPoint, then I expect 0 interval
Given within four days of expiration, when I setDownloadNotifierToTriggerAtHalfwayPoint, then I expect to be notified on the last day
Given a DIALOG type, when I snoozeDownloadNotifier, then I expect null
Given a repeat expiration time, when I setDownloadNotifierToTriggerAtHalfwayPoint, then I expect to return the exact same state

Given more than four days until expiration, when I setDownloadNotifierToTriggerAtHalfwayPoint, then I expect to be notified at the halfway point
